description: Constant capacity below offered load: the controller sheds the excess, holding admitted near k*capacity and goodput near capacity (a smooth plateau, no sawtooth).
A sudden capacity drop pushes the rejection probability from zero up to a steady shedding level.
After a capacity collapse and shedding, restored capacity drives the rejection probability back to zero (k>1 guarantees the gate fully reopens).
Capacity steps down gradually; the rejection probability steps up to match each lower ceiling.
